content.short: Glider analyzes smart contract codes on EVM chains rapidly.
content.description: Glider helps bug hunters identify critical vulnerabilities across all EVM chains with ease and can help earn up to 10x more on bounties. Its taint analysis and other advanced features enable a distributable, scalable code-analysis workflow. As a fast code-query engine, Glider performs variant- and data-analysis on verified smart-contract code across integrated EVM blockchains, delivering rapid, comprehensive security insights for teams.
